screenshots.name: desktop-pending-calculation.png
screenshots.findings: The labeled 5 s and 10 s setup cards use solid and dashed edges. The baseline 50 W is prominent. Stage 1 has compact radio cards with a stronger selected border; stage 2 shows a blank labeled W entry. Primary check actions are clear and stage 3 remains withheld.

screenshots.name: desktop-checked-calculation.png
screenshots.findings: All three numbered stages are readable. The 25 W answer is checked, and the contained comparison panel clearly presents 50 W × 0.5 ≈ 25 W with solid and striped bars. Desktop columns, baseline, primary actions and feedback fit cleanly.

screenshots.name: dark-phone-energy-calculation.png
screenshots.findings: At a 320-pixel dark viewport, setup cards and radio choices stack. The complete selector, baseline 250 J, selected same prediction, large 250 J entry and three stage headings remain clear. Full-width primary buttons and the contained comparison panel fit without clipping.

screenshots.name: forced-colors-phone-load-calculation.png
screenshots.findings: At a 320-pixel forced-colors viewport, solid/dashed setup borders, numbered stages, strong selected card and primary buttons remain distinct. The 312.5 W entry, wrapped equation and solid/striped shared-scale bars fit within the panel.

limitations: Native React/THREE with local Chromium software WebGL; no deployed host build exercised.
Forced colors is browser emulation; no physical assistive technology session.
